      "snippet": "Yep, you can absolutely do this on Android with Termux. Let me just hand you the exact commands so you don’t have to think. 🧱
I’ll assume:

You downloaded all_in_one_export.zip in your browser on Android

It’s in the usual Downloads folder

1️⃣ One-time Termux setup (if you haven’t done this yet)
Open Termux and run:
bashCopy codepkg update -y
pkg install -y unzip
termux-setup-storage

Termux will pop up an Android permission dialog → allow storage access.

This will mount your shared storage at"
